missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend choline solely for a cognitive-support goal; review diet and existing supplements.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim choline supplements improve cognition in generally healthy people without condition-specific evidence.
Do not infer deficiency from memory or concentration complaints.
Do not duplicate choline in existing products.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, liver disease, neurological symptoms or diagnosed cognitive disorder requiring clinical assessment.
population_and_context: People selecting cognitive support as a goal without an established choline deficiency or specific clinical indication.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Compare dietary and supplemental intake with age- and life-stage adequate intake and upper limit.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Choline fact sheet provides intake and evidence context; a wellness goal does not establish benefit from supplementation. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
